findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_print_qa_services, prepare_printcheck_document · Private data: prepare_printcheck_document · Public sink: prepare_preflight, prepare_printcheck, prepare_curve_clearance, prepare_small_features, prepare_vector_health, prepare_cutting_paths, prepare_native_vector_health, prepare_round_halftone, prepare_cylinder_projection, prepare_palette_assignment, prepare_duplicate_contours, prepare_printcheck_document, prepare_printcheck_raster, prepare_raster_trace, prepare_cnc_simplify, prepare_print_separator · Destructive: prepare_cnc_simplify.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_print_qa_services, prepare_printcheck_document · Private data: prepare_printcheck_document · Public sink: prepare_preflight, prepare_printcheck, prepare_curve_clearance, prepare_small_features, prepare_vector_health, prepare_cutting_paths, prepare_native_vector_health, prepare_round_halftone, prepare_cylinder_projection, prepare_palette_assignment, prepare_duplicate_contours, prepare_printcheck_document, prepare_printcheck_raster, prepare_raster_trace, prepare_cnc_simplify, prepare_print_separator · Destructive: prepare_cnc_simplify

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
